name: dsa-tracker
description: DSA Tracker — LeetCode progress tracking platform for Kalvium mentors

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dsa/shared && npm run build -w @dsa/api && npm run build -w @dsa/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @dsa/api" "npm run dev -w @dsa/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dsa/shared && npm run test -w @dsa/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dsa/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dsa/api && npm run typecheck -w @dsa/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @dsa/api && npm run lint -w @dsa/web
